rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is just or only a particular thing, with no more implied.

example.english: This place is a mere cha chaan teng.
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 zi2 hai6 jat1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1

rows.note: Use this when stressing that something is no more than what follows, often with a dismissive or minimizing tone.

example.english: He is a mere employee; there is no need to be so polite.
example.traditional: 佢不過係一個打工仔，唔使咁客氣。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bat1 gwo3 hai6 jat1 go3 daa2 gung1 zai2 m4 sai2 gam3 haak3 hei3

rows.note: Use this formal written adjective for the pure-and-simple sense rather than the everyday constructions.

example.english: The incident was a mere misunderstanding.
example.jyutping: si6 gin6 seoi6 suk6 ng6 wui6
